purpose: Shared core-module catalog and version-pinned acceptance requirements

limitations: The catalog records comparison requirements, not runtime parity results.
A null defaultOn records an absent default flag. The manager enables an unconfigured module only when its defaultOn is truthy.
The older r2 migration list is not the current catalog; obsolete starred is not an additional registered module.
English labels and workflow requirements are independently authored benchmark descriptions.

commonCases.description: Enable/disable through Core plugins settings; remove/restore owned commands, views and hooks; isolate state between vaults.
Match the reference's settings availability and behavior, read existing configuration, round-trip changes and preserve unknown fields; do not invent a settings page for a module without one.
Close and restart the desktop process; retain enablement, configuration and feature data without changing unrelated vault files.

workflows.description: Create a nested note, reveal its folders, highlight it and reopen its exact saved content through the file tree.
Create folders and rename/move/delete notes and attachments, including collisions, cancellation and reference updates.
Search note contents with text, Boolean, regex, path/tag/property operators; navigate to the correct matching context.
Refresh results after edits, file operations and external changes; report invalid queries explicitly.
Open with Ctrl+O, fuzzy-filter a nested note and open the selected result with its exact content.
Use Ctrl+Enter to open a result in a new tab; handle missing-note creation and empty results consistently.
Show global/local graphs for linked, unresolved and orphan notes; navigate from nodes and update after edits.
Apply filters, groups, local depth and display controls; retain their configuration.
Resolve linked/unlinked mentions, headings and blocks; navigate to source context and update on edit/rename.
Open existing .canvas files with text/file/web cards, groups and edges; edit/save/reopen without losing unknown JSON fields.
Pan, zoom, select, move and connect cards; exercise keyboard navigation and undo/redo.
List resolved/unresolved outgoing links, navigate/create targets, and update after editing or renaming.
List inline/property tags with nested groups and counts; click to search and refresh after edits without indexing escaped/code text.
Open the footnotes side view, list definitions/references and navigate between them as the note changes.
View/edit typed YAML properties while preserving the note body, unknown keys and supported existing serialization.
List vault properties, filter/sort them and apply supported name/type changes consistently across notes.
Use the configured hover/modifier behavior on links, headings and blocks; render the correct target and clean up dismissed previews.
Create/open today's note using date format, folder and template settings without duplicating or overwriting an existing note.
Navigate previous/next daily notes with the reference's date and missing-file behavior.
Choose a configured template and insert at the selection with title/date/time substitutions without modifying the template.
Insert current date/time using configured formats and preserve surrounding editor text.
Merge notes with the chosen source-file handling, update references and avoid data loss on conflicts/cancellation.
Extract a selection into a new/existing note with supported link/embed options and preserve surrounding text.
Open with Ctrl+P, filter and select a real built-in command; verify its effect and palette dismissal.
Respect command availability/editor context and configured pinned-command behavior.
Type slash in a supported editor context, filter/execute a command and remove its query without damaging surrounding Markdown.
Display and switch reading/source/Live Preview modes per leaf with correct active-file state and configuration.
Bookmark supported files/folders/headings/blocks/searches, group/reorder/rename/remove them and retain compatible bookmark data.
Open bookmark targets, update renamed references and handle missing targets explicitly.
Convert the reference-supported legacy Markdown/link formats on fixture copies with correct confirmation, cancellation and preservation of unrelated text.
Create timestamp-prefixed notes using configured name/folder/template behavior; handle collisions without overwriting.
Open only eligible vault notes and report an empty vault rather than selecting an attachment or invalid path.
Show the active note's ATX headings and move the editor to the selected source heading.
Match heading/fence/Setext handling, hierarchy, folding and active-heading updates for the reference fixtures.
Display exact word/character counts for a known ASCII document and update them immediately after editing.
Match reference counts for selection, Unicode/CJK/emoji, punctuation and supported editor/reading modes.
Present Markdown slide separators, rendered content/embeds and navigation; exit back to the intact note.

plugins.name: Audio recorder
dependencies: Authorized microphone access or a deterministic synthetic input device; do not record private ambient audio.

workflows.description: Start/stop with synthetic input, save a playable vault attachment and embed it; handle permission/codec failure and cancellation explicitly.
Restore per-vault split/tab/pin/sidebar layout and note contents after renderer reload without rewriting Obsidian workspace.json; this is only a foundation, not named-workspace support.
Save, load, rename/delete named workspaces with their leaf/view state; preserve dirty notes and compatible workspace configuration.
Create persistent snapshots, find/preview versions of modified/deleted notes and restore with explicit conflict handling.
Honor snapshot interval/retention settings across restart without treating normal unsaved buffers as recovery snapshots.

plugins.name: Publish
dependencies: Authorized Obsidian Publish account/site and service access; a local desktop rewrite does not supply the hosted service.

workflows.description: On an authorized test site, select/publish/remove notes and attachments, resolve links and report account/network failures; never include credentials in evidence.

plugins.name: Sync
dependencies: Authorized Obsidian Sync account/remote vault and service access; local file persistence is not cloud synchronization.

workflows.description: Exercise authorized remote-vault setup, notes/attachments/configuration, offline reconciliation, conflicts and encryption behavior with a second client.
Open existing .base views with filters, sorts, grouping and formulas against real note properties; navigate results.
Edit supported values/view configuration, preserve note and .base data across restart, and surface formula/type errors.
Open an authorized test page in a web view with navigation/find/link handling, retained view state and correct external-navigation boundaries.
